body.statement: There exist constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that \(c\le V_P\le C\) for every \(P\in\mathcal P_4\), and for every fixed \(p\in(2,3)\), \[\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_4}E_P|D(O)|^p<\infty.\] One admissible envelope is a class constant times \(1+\Delta/(1-U)+\log\{1/(1-U)\}\).
body.justification: Uniform Studentization must be justified with more than two moments but without the false third- or fourth-moment shortcut.
body.gap: Jing, Shao, and Wang (2003) treat self-normalized independent sums under finite \(2+\delta\) moments, while Westling et al. (2024) use bounded influence functions supplied by censoring positivity.
body.consumer: This envelope supports ratio-consistent empirical influence variance and uniform Gaussian approximation for the feasible cross-fitted statistic.
